ROOT="/bench/repo"

is_data_layer() {
  local pkg="$1"

  [[ -z "$name" ]] && continue
  case "$name" in

  esac
  case "$name" in
    Find*|Update*|Delete*|Create*) continue ;;
  esac
  case "$name" in
    *Result|*QueryResult|*Mutation) continue ;;
  esac
  ENTITY_DECL["$name"]="${file#$ROOT/}"
done < <(grep -h "^type [A-Za-z0-9_]* struct" "$ROOT"/store/*.go 2>/dev/null | while read -r l; do
  # need file context - redo with grep -n on each file
  :
done)

# Better approach: loop files
for f in "$ROOT"/store/*.go; do
  [[ "$f" == *_test.go ]] && continue
  base="${f#$ROOT/}"
  while IFS= read -r name; do
    [[ -z "$name" ]] && continue
    case "$name" in
      Store|Cache|Config) continue ;;
      Find*|Update*|Delete*|Create*) continue ;;
      *Result|*QueryResult|*Mutation) continue ;;
    esac
    ENTITY_DECL["$name"]="$base"
  done < <(grep -oP '^type \K[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?= struct)' "$f")
done

echo "=== Entity types (${#ENTITY_DECL[@]}) ==="
for name in $(printf '%s\n' "${!ENTITY_DECL[@]}" | sort); do
  echo "  $name -> ${ENTITY_DECL[$name]}"
done

# Build list of non-data-layer go files
mapfile -t ALL_FILES < <(find "$ROOT" -name '*.go' \
  ! -path '*/.git/*' \
  ! -path '*/web/*' \
  -print)

count_refs() {
  local entity="$1"
  local include_tests="$2"
  declare -A SEEN_PKGS
  declare -A PKG_FILES

  for f in "${ALL_FILES[@]}"; do
    $include_tests || { is_test_file "$f" && continue; }
    dir=$(dirname "$f")
    pkg="${dir#$ROOT/}"
    [[ "$pkg" == "." ]] && pkg=""
    is_data_layer "$pkg" && continue

    if grep -qE "(store\.|\*store\.|\[\]store\.|storepb\.)${entity}\b" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
      SEEN_PKGS["$pkg"]=1
      rel="${f#$ROOT/}"
      if [[ -z "${PKG_FILES[$pkg]:-}" ]]; then
        PKG_FILES[$pkg]="$rel"
      else
        PKG_FILES[$pkg]+=", $rel"
      fi
    fi
  done

  local count=${#SEEN_PKGS[@]}
  echo "$count"
  for pkg in $(printf '%s\n' "${!SEEN_PKGS[@]}" | sort); do
    echo "  PKG|$pkg|${PKG_FILES[$pkg]}"
  done
}

echo ""
echo "=== Reference counts (no tests) ==="
declare -a RANK
for entity in $(printf '%s\n' "${!ENTITY_DECL[@]}" | sort); do
  output=$(count_refs "$entity" false)
  count=$(echo "$output" | head -1)
  RANK+=("$count|$entity|${ENTITY_DECL[$entity]}")
  echo "--- $entity: $count packages ---"
  echo "$output" | tail -n +2
done

echo ""
echo "=== RANKING ==="
printf '%s\n' "${RANK[@]}" | sort -t'|' -k1,1nr | head -20

echo ""
echo "=== With tests (counts only) ==="
for entity in $(printf '%s\n' "${!ENTITY_DECL[@]}" | sort); do
  c=$(count_refs "$entity" true | head -1)
  echo "$c|$entity"
done | sort -t'|' -k1,1nr | head -10
BASH

bash << 'BASH'
ROOT="/bench/repo"

is_data_layer() {
  local pkg="$1"
  [[ "$pkg" == "store" || "$pkg" == store/* ]]
}

is_test_file() {
  local f="$1"
  [[ "$f" == *_test.go || "$f" == */test/* ]]
}

get_pkg() {
  local f="$1"
  local dir=$(dirname "$f")
  local pkg="${dir#$ROOT/}"
  [[ "$pkg" == "." ]] && pkg=""
  echo "$pkg"
}

# Exported entity types only from store/*.go root
declare -A ENTITY_DECL
for f in "$ROOT"/store/*.go; do
  [[ "$f" == *_test.go ]] && continue
  base="${f#$ROOT/}"
  while IFS= read -r name; do
    [[ "$name" =~ ^[A-Z] ]] || continue
    case "$name" in
      Store|Cache|Config) continue ;;
      Find*|Update*|Delete*|Create*) continue ;;
      *Result|*QueryResult|*Mutation) continue ;;
    esac
    ENTITY_DECL["$name"]="$base"
  done < <(grep -oP '^type \K[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?= struct)' "$f")
done

mapfile -t ALL_FILES < <(find "$ROOT" -name '*.go' ! -path '*/.git/*' ! -path '*/web/*' -print)

file_references_entity() {
  local f="$1"
  local entity="$2"
  local content
  content=$(cat "$f")

  # Explicit qualified references
  if echo "$content" | grep -qE "(store\.|\*store\.|\[\]store\.|storepb\.)${entity}\b"; then
    return 0
  fi

  # Unqualified if imports store package
  if echo "$content" | grep -q '"github.com/usememos/memos/store"'; then
    # More specific patterns for unqualified use
    if echo "$content" | grep -qE "\b${entity}\b"; then
      # Exclude if only in comments? rough check for type usage
      if echo "$content" | grep -qE "(\*?${entity}\b|\[\]${entity}\b|func.*\) ${entity}|${entity}\)|, ${entity}|${entity},|\*${entity}|${entity}\{)"; then
        return 0
      fi
    fi
  fi
  return 1
}

count_refs() {
  local entity="$1"
  local include_tests="$2"
  declare -A SEEN_PKGS
  declare -A PKG_FILES

  for f in "${ALL_FILES[@]}"; do
    $include_tests || { is_test_file "$f" && continue; }
    pkg=$(get_pkg "$f")
    is_data_layer "$pkg" && continue
    file_references_entity "$f" "$entity" || continue
    SEEN_PKGS["$pkg"]=1
    rel="${f#$ROOT/}"
    PKG_FILES[$pkg]="${PKG_FILES[$pkg]:+$PKG_FILES[$pkg], }$rel"
  done

  echo "${#SEEN_PKGS[@]}"
  for pkg in $(printf '%s\n' "${!SEEN_PKGS[@]}" | sort); do
    echo "  $pkg :: ${PKG_FILES[$pkg]}"
  done
}

echo "=== Exported persistent entity types (${#ENTITY_DECL[@]}) ==="
for n in $(printf '%s\n' "${!ENTITY_DECL[@]}" | sort); do echo "  $n -> ${ENTITY_DECL[$n]}"; done

echo ""
echo "=== REFERENCE ANALYSIS (exclude tests, exclude data layer) ==="
declare -a RANK
for entity in $(printf '%s\n' "${!ENTITY_DECL[@]}" | sort); do
  output=$(count_refs "$entity" false)
  count=$(echo "$output" | head -1)
  RANK+=("$count|$entity|${ENTITY_DECL[$entity]}")
done

printf '%s\n' "${RANK[@]}" | sort -t'|' -k1,1nr | while IFS='|' read -r c e d; do
  echo ""
  echo "## $e ($c packages) - $d"
  count_refs "$e" false | tail -n +2
done

echo ""
echo "=== TOP 2 SUMMARY ==="
printf '%s\n' "${RANK[@]}" | sort -t'|' -k1,1nr | head -2

echo ""
echo "=== With tests (top 5) ==="
for entity in $(printf '%s\n' "${!ENTITY_DECL[@]}" | sort); do
  c=$(count_refs "$entity" true | head -1)
  echo "$c|$entity"
done | sort -t'|' -k1,1nr | head -5

# Check internal and cmd specifically
echo ""
echo "=== internal/ references to store entities ==="
for f in $(find "$ROOT/internal" -name '*.go' ! -name '*_test.go' 2>/dev/null); do
  for entity in User Memo Attachment; do
    if file_references_entity "$f" "$entity"; then
      echo "  $(get_pkg "$f"): $entity in ${f#$ROOT/}"
    fi
  done
done

echo ""
echo "=== cmd/ references ==="
for f in $(find "$ROOT/cmd" -name '*.go' ! -name '*_test.go' 2>/dev/null); do
  if grep -q 'github.com/usememos/memos/store' "$f"; then
    echo "  ${f#$ROOT/}"
    grep -n 'store\.' "$f" | head -5
  fi
done
BASH
